Neha (CS): Heads up — Hightide renewal in 28 days. Need an SLO evidence pack for their review: uptime target 99.9% and p95 latency < 150ms on generation route. Can SRE + Data pull a compact bundle (30d) and an enablement checklist? @Sam @Lena
Sam (SRE): Can do. Do they run hosted or dedicated?
Ravi (AcctMgr): They're on Dedicated, pinned to eu-west-1. Also asked about how credits would be calculated if we miss p95.
Neha (CS): Confirm Dedicated. Requested deliverables: 1) daily uptime with incident list, 2) latency histogram (p50/p95/p99), 3) sample traces for the two incidents last month, 4) proposed credit calc per our SLA table. Also a 1-slide summary for the customer call.
Lena (Data): I can export metrics. Need the exact service name — is it 'hightide-gen-route' or something else?
Marco (Sales): It's gen-hightide-prod (legacy name).
Sam (SRE): Ok — I'll snapshot metrics and traces and drop into an S3 folder: metrics.csv, traces.tar.gz, incidents.md. ETA EOD tomorrow. Kicking off the export now.
Sam (SRE): PromQL I'm running for latency p95: ```histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"gen-hightide-prod\"}[5m])) by (le))``` and uptime: ```sum(up{job=\"gen-hightide-prod\"}) / count(up{job=\"gen-hightide-prod\"})```
Lena (Data): For credits calc I'll apply the SLA formula: credit = min(0.25 * monthly_fee, (downtime_seconds / total_seconds) * monthly_fee). I'll produce a sample calculation and a CSV.
Neha (CS): Also please include latency windows we accept internally: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 150ms, p99 < 500ms. Customer asked about tail risk and our rollback/fallback policy when quantized models are used. Add a short note.
Ravi (AcctMgr): I'll schedule a rehearsal call Thursday 10am PT. @Marco can you join for pricing and credit questions?
Marco (Sales): Yup. I'll bring the renewal deck and provisional credit table.
deploy-bot: New artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-cs-packages/hightide/3765432100/ (metrics.csv, traces.tar.gz, incidents.md)
Neha (CS): Thanks — action items: Sam upload artifacts; Lena deliver metrics.csv + credit_calc.csv; Marco & Ravi schedule the call; Neha will draft the customer-facing slide. I'll chase Friday if no updates. :thumbsup:
Sam (SRE): Started export — progress 12% (logs).
Lena (Data): Beginning credit calc now, will post sample table here when ready.
Marco (Sales): Scheduled rehearsal invite sent to the group.
Neha (CS): Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me and I'll escalate to eng-ops.
Ravi (AcctMgr): Noted, thanks everyone.
Neha (CS): Closing thread when docs uploaded.
